what_changed: COLLECTOR DEFECT 5 FIXED -- a malformed LINK aborted the collection. _linked called Path(value) on whatever the controller report carried and caught only OSError, so authoring_log: [] raised TypeError out of collect() and destroyed a readable workload result beside it. Link values are now shape-checked, a non-string is a malformed-link OBSERVATION that is reported and not followed, and the whole linkage pass is additionally guarded so it cannot cost the artifacts their results. This was in the revision that fixed the malformed-REPORT case, which is the uncomfortable part.

COLLECTOR DEFECTS 6 AND 7 FIXED -- cross-artifact filename inference. The directory is now listed ONCE and every name classified by anchored pattern, so each artifact sees only its own finals and its own temporaries. The real names were read from the producers rather than guessed: the workload temporary is outcome.json.partial (baseline.py:1006, path + ".partial") and NOT a .tmp, while with_suffix(".tmp") REPLACES .json so the controller temporary is outcome.json.enforcement-<pid>-<ns>.tmp and not ...json.tmp. The infix groups are [^.]+ so outcome.json.manager-*.json can no longer swallow ...json.progress.json. The shutdown request is collected as a sixth artifact, composed packet members are recognised, and directory_entries plus unclassified_entries are reported WITHOUT being used to infer any artifact state.

FALSE PRODUCER CLAIM WITHDRAWN. The previous packet said a child publication timeout reaches the progress file. It does not. Shutdown.call (authoring_shutdown.py:72-86) enters bounded(deadline, step) FIRST -- an exhausted deadline raises before any write -- then writes its snapshot carrying the faults of EARLIER calls, then runs the step, then on failure appends that step fault to MEMORY ONLY and re-raises. final enforcement publication (authoring_enforcement.py:493) is the LAST such call in the controller finally, so nothing flushes it; outer outcome publication is not a Shutdown.call at all; and workload publication (baseline.py:1461) is followed by later calls only in main, reached only if control gets there and each re-entering bounded() against the same exhausted deadline. CONCLUSION, now carried in collect.py PUBLICATION_PERSISTENCE, TASK item (e), SHUTDOWN rule 3 and COMMANDS 5d: this vehicle persists NO publication fault reliably, absence is EXPECTED and informative in neither direction, and a fault found on disk is PARSED and labelled as such rather than treated as producer evidence. The verdict field is renamed parsed_publication_faults accordingly.
